subject: error in lavann: contains a reserved word

messages.author: ccfd54bb3a2c4bcb
messages.subject: error in lavann: contains a reserved word
parts:
Hi all,

I was trying to include a covarying relationship between two product terms in my model. However, I keep getting the error below: 

Error in lavParseModelString(model) : 
  lavaan ERROR: left hand side (lhs) of this formula:
    x2:x4 ~~ x1:x3
    contains a reserved word (in R): “x2:x4”
    see ?reserved for a list of reserved words in R
    please use a variable name that is not a reserved word in R

Has anybody had this error before? Is there a way to fix it?

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: error in lavann: contains a reserved word
parts:
While lavaan now allows interactions among exogenous predictors using the familiar colon operator from ?formula objects, it can only be used on the righthand side of an operator.  Because products should only be among exogenous predictors using the colon operator, you don't have to estimate their covariance explicitly, just set fixed.x=TRUE (which is typically the default anyway) so that the sample statistics are assumed rather than estimated.  If for some reason you are using products among endogenous variables (e.g., product indicators of a latent interaction term, or moderated mediation), then you should create product terms as new variables in your data set, rather than use the colon operator.  If you are using product indicators of a latent interaction term, then you should also double-mean-center them instead of using simple products (read the reference on the ?indProd help page in the semTools package).
